derivation: Readable JavaScript derived from the pinned TypeScript sources using TypeScript 7.0.2, removing imports/type-only declarations and expanding the bounds-check macro. The resulting JavaScript is maintained directly. Public declarations derive from the published package.
changes: Shared iterator navigation methods and one lazy live pair proxy per iterator.
Reject foreign, detached and cleared iterators; retained pairs cannot access end sentinels.
Validate integer positions and use existing subtree counts for logarithmic indexed position access.
Reverse-end predecessor returns the smallest key; empty predecessor throws RangeError.
Index access without enableIndex throws RangeError instead of returning inconsistent values.
Array constructor overload contextually types tuple literals and permits readonly input pairs.
scope: The complete OrderedMap runtime method surface is retained. Iterator pair identity is now stable; deletion still swaps node payloads as upstream does, so callers must not rely on unrelated iterators retaining a particular key across erase. No runtime dependencies.
